Chrome Web Store support for 3zT, bundled from:
  electron-chrome-web-store 0.13.0 (MIT) - https://github.com/samuelmaddock/electron-browser-shell (commit 3817c42)
  adm-zip 0.5.16 (MIT) - https://github.com/cthackers/adm-zip
  pbf 4.0.1 (BSD-3-Clause) - https://github.com/mapbox/pbf
Changes: installer calls globalThis.__zeusCwsUnpacked(dir, manifest) before loading, so 3zT can add its compatibility shim.
         downloads go through Electron net.fetch (Chromium network stack, system proxy) instead of Node fetch.
         a failed update check (offline) no longer becomes an unhandled promise rejection.
